content.title: Offline count conflict: add counts instead of overwrite
content.statement: When two offline counts of the same batch conflict, the app keeps both changes and adds them together, instead of keeping only the last count.
content.context: Two offline counts of the same batch conflict.
content.rationale: Sofia explained that growers often split one bench between two people, so both counts are usually real.

sources.excerpt: Decision: when two offline counts of the same batch conflict, the app keeps both changes and adds them together, instead of keeping only the last count.
Sofia explained that growers often split one bench between two people, so both counts are usually real.
When two phones count the same bench offline, the phone that syncs last overwrites the other count.
